### Prerequisites (each listed separately)

1. `deposit_ext_recalculation_refund` → `deposit_ext_refund_date_interest`, form **state**. policy_source "The recalculation refund is not made until the deposit ledger carries an interest accrual whose period ends on the refund date." — verbatim in hub `deposit_recalculation_refund_e7774ce3` rule 4, with a same-form restatement in the same doc ("while the ledger shows no interest accrual whose period ends on the refund date, there is no recalculation refund to pay"); in no other doc. Resolution basis: the depended-on hub's "Business effect: an interest accrual entry on the deposit ledger whose period ends on the refund date" (the sentence's own words) + ledger (last period end 2024-12-31). Strength ("not made until") equal.
2. `deposit_ext_refund_date_interest` → `deposit_ext_year_end_interest`, form **state**. policy_source "The refund-date accrual is worked out only after the deposit ledger carries a December 31 accrual for every earlier calendar year in which cash was held." — verbatim in hub `refund_date_interest_posting_c0f8a818` § Rule, plus the same-form restatement "In other words, the part-year accrual … waits on the deposit ledger: each earlier calendar year in which the deposit held cash must already show its December 31 accrual there"; in no other doc. Resolution basis: hub `year_end_interest_posting_2da691e8` ("posts the December 31 accrual of a calendar year on a cash deposit that was held in full for the whole of that year"; business effect "an interest accrual entry on the deposit ledger for the year") + ledger (2023 and 2024 accruals only, cash held through 2025). Strength equal. The year-end docs do not mention the refund-date accrual.
